summary: Both blocking findings are valid and directly repairable in spec.json by defining the submodule halt envelope contract and force retry failure path.

items.title: Submodule halt envelope contract is undefined
items.rationale: The current spec requires cause-specific recovery guidance but does not name the machine-readable envelope contract needed for implementation and tests.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements R4/R7 mention halt and diagnostics, but no error code or required data payload distinguishes dirty root, dirty submodule, and status inspection failure.

items.title: Force retry failure path is omitted
items.rationale: The force retry is a destructive cleanup boundary; the spec must state that branch deletion does not proceed if the retry fails and must define the failure envelope.
items.evidence: spec.json R3 and data_flow describe successful force retry only; acceptance criteria do not cover force retry failure.
